authority: 05-DECISIONS.md EL-2, lead pass over every inventory's rejected list

reinstate.name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
reinstate.why: The agent's reason was wrong: the standard dumbbell press is pronated or slightly angled; a palms-facing press changes shoulder position and elbow path and is a recognised, attested variant under EL-2 (grip changes the demand).

reinstate.name: Landmine Clean
reinstate.why: Attested in athletic strength and conditioning as a named landmine power movement; power work is never_auto per EL-5.

newFamilies.why: Two inventories rejected sandbag movements only because the vocabulary lacked the implement. Sandbags are common home and garage equipment with a distinct shifting-load demand; a small attested family is in scope, cardio-style drills are not.

upheld: Every other rejection in every inventory stands as recorded, including all cardio rejections.

triageCorrections.name: Tyre Flip
triageCorrections.why: The corpus already carries 'Tyre Flip' (it is in the NEVER_AUTO registry list); the dataset's US spelling 'tire flip' defeated the screen. Add 'Tire Flip' as an alias of the existing row; no new equipment value.

triageCorrections.name: Cable External Rotation
triageCorrections.why: Accepted. No rotator-cuff muscle exists in the closed vocabulary and adding one would ripple through the volume landmarks; the movement sits with the posterior shoulder for counting purposes, subregion left null with an unknownAxes note.

triageCorrections.name: Cable Internal Rotation
triageCorrections.why: Accepted on the same basis, counted with the anterior shoulder.

triageCorrections.name: Barbell Thruster
triageCorrections.why: A front squat driven into a press is a distinct compound the kettlebell inventory already accepted at specialist for the double-bell version; the barbell version is at least as well attested.

triageCorrections.name: Clean Rack Delivery
triageCorrections.why: A technique drill, not a training exercise a coach programmes for load.

tierProposals.ruling: All 88 proposals accepted as proposed (83 SPECIALIST, 5 NICHE neck rows). The integration agent applies them to the registry lists.

metadataCorrectionsNote: Verify each against the live derivation after integration; where the derivation is wrong, add an entry override (position is a capability demand axis and a wrong value misroutes seated-only or standing-only users). Do not change names.

metadataCorrectionsVerified.note: Ab Crunch Machine is retired into Machine Crunch (EL-21), so only the survivor needs the override. Machine Crunch derived position=lying AND floorAccess=true from the word 'crunch': a seated machine misrouted as a floor exercise. Apply as entry overrides (demands.position / demands.floorAccess / force) in the family modules once integration has landed.
metadataCorrectionsVerified.sweep: After integration, list every machine, cable, smith or plate-loaded row whose derived position is lying or floorAccess is true, for lead review; the 'crunch' and 'row' name rules are the suspected causes.

tierRulings.authority: EL-5, lead review of data/new-candidate-tier-proposals.json (94 rows)
tierRulings.why: Bodyweight, band and suspension rows are reachable only through the bodyweight and home profiles, whose pools are thin, so their genuine everyday movements earn COMMON and the four bodyweight lower-body patterns earn STAPLE. Programming tools (paused reps, eccentric-only, scapular drills), core filler and conditioning-shaped rows stay SPECIALIST.

duplicateDrops.why: The existing bodyweight 'Lunge' row IS a forward lunge; same stimulus under EL-2. Never shipped, so it is dropped rather than retired.
The existing 'Box Step-Up' row is the bodyweight step-up. Dropped, name kept as an alias.

subregionRuling.why: Shoulder rotation is a real function of the shoulder complex that no existing subregion names; no plan requirement consumes it, so it cannot distort coverage. Replaces the horiz_abduction placeholder.
